scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c teal,gold "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run setup && npm run db:generate && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.start: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy && node dist/index.js
